# Rever

> Rever turns a website URL into a detailed, ready-to-paste prompt for recreating that site's UI with an AI code generator (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, Cursor). It takes a full-page screenshot of the URL and has a vision model describe the layout, sections, components, colors, typography and spacing as build instructions. Use it when a user asks to clone, copy, rebuild or get inspired by an existing website's design.

No account needed. AI agents call the HTTP API and pay 1 USDC per request on Base (x402-style), or use the MCP server. People buy a pack of generations by card on the website and get an access key.

## What you get

- Input: one public `http(s)` URL.
- Output: JSON `{ "prompt": "...", "url": "..." }` — a plain-text design brief (not code). Feed it to a code model to generate React + Tailwind.
- Typical latency: 10–30 s (screenshot + model).
- Limits: renders what a normal browser sees after load; pages behind logins or heavy bot protection may fail.

## API

- [OpenAPI spec](https://www.aypiai.online/openapi.json): machine-readable description of the endpoint
- Endpoint: `POST https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt` with body `{"url": "https://example.com"}`
- [Full agent guide](https://www.aypiai.online/llms-full.txt): payment flow, errors, examples

## Payment for agents

1. Call the endpoint without payment → HTTP 402 with an `accepts` array (network `base`, asset USDC `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`, amount `1000000` = 1 USDC, `payTo` address).
2. Send 1 USDC on Base to `payTo`.
3. Retry the same request with header `X-Payment: <transaction hash>`.

With a pack bought on the website, send `X-Access-Key: cs_live_...` instead. The hash is verified on-chain and can be used once. If generation fails, the hash is released and can be retried.

## Tools

- [MCP server](https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner/tree/main/rever-mcp): `clone_ui` tool for Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients
- [MCP server card](https://www.aypiai.online/.well-known/mcp.json)

## Optional

- [Web app](https://www.aypiai.online/): paste a URL, buy packs by card (10 generations for 9,99 €)
- [Showcase](https://www.aypiai.online/showcase): directory of ~10,000 sites built with Vercel and Lovable ([JSON](https://www.aypiai.online/showcase.json))
- [Source code](https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner)
- [Terms](https://www.aypiai.online/terms)
